slides.title: Someone DMs you "how much is it?" Which reply actually *books the call*?
slides.sub: Same lead, same question, 4 replies. Only one of them gets the call booked.

slides.title: Which reply books the call?
slides.incoming: ok this sounds like exactly what I need, how much is it?
options: It's $1,500! Here's my calendar, grab any slot that works for you.
Check the link in my bio, everything is explained there.
Great question! What made you reach out today?
It's $1,500, or 3 payments of $550. Before I send times, how many clients are you working with right now?
slides.footer: 1, 2, 3 or 4? Tell me in the comments.

slides.title: Why the other three lose the lead
items: Reply 1 sends your calendar to anyone who asks, so your week fills up with calls from people who were never a fit.
Reply 2 sends a warm lead away from the chat, right when they were ready to talk.
Reply 3 dodges the price, and a dodge is the fastest way to sound like a script.
